name: OEP Online Evolutionary Planning (purchase, combat move, non-combat move)
description: Online Evolutionary Planning of Justesen et al. (2018) for the purchase, combat move and non-combat move: genomes of 3 actions, population 100, survival rate 0.5, uniform crossover keeping genes legal, mutation probability 0.1 (later illegal genes regenerated), static heuristic evaluation (fixed dice per search, cached, survivors not re-evaluated); plays the best genome found in the time budget.
